senses.gloss: ध्म mfn. blowing, a blower (cf. तूण-, शङ्क-).
ध्मात॑ mfn. blown, blown up or into, RV. &c. &c.
ध्मात॑ n. a partic. wrong pronunciation of vowels, Pat.
ध्मा˚तव्य mfn. to be blown or kindled, Kull.
ध्मा॑तृ m. a blower, smelter or melter (of metal), RV. v, 9, 5
ध्मातृ॑ n. a contrivance for blowing or melting, ib.
ध्मान n. blowing, puffing, swelling, Suśr.
ध्मापन (Caus. of √ धम्) n. the act of reducing to (powder, &c.) or any contrivance for it, Car.
ध्मा˚पित mfn. reduced to ashes, burnt to a cinder (क्षौम), Suśr.
ध्मायत्, mf(अन्ती)n. or ध्मा˚यमान, mfn. being blown, being melted &c., MW.
ध्मायत्, mf(अन्ती)n. or ध्मा˚यमान, mfn. being blown, being melted &c., MW.
ध्माङ्क्ष m. w.r. for ध्वङ्क्ष, a crow.
ध्मामन् w.r. for ध्यामन्, Uṇ. iv, 152.
